description: External auditor engagement contract record. G5 UPL-EQUIVALENT BOUNDARY: toritate prepares the data package and records the engagement, but does NOT render the opinion. Opinion document CID is the external auditor's; toritate does NOT modify it. Typical use case: US 501(c)(3) equivalent-determination opinion letter ($5-15k from US tax counsel) enabling chigiri.taxReceipt US donor receipt routing.

externalAuditorIdentity.description: External auditor firm name (PII filter does not redact firm names; firm DIDs preferred where available)

publicFundSafeContractCid.description: Public Fund Safe contract CID authorizing the engagement (G5 boundary — toritate does NOT directly engage; Public Fund Safe Council Lv6+ does)

councilAttestations.description: ≥4 Council Lv6+ DIDs (per Public Fund Safe Council Lv6+ ≥4/7 supermajority for engagement budget approval)

estimatedBudgetUsdMillicents.description: Estimated cost; e.g., US 501(c)(3) eq-det opinion ~$5-15k = ~500000000-1500000000 millicents

actualBudgetUsdMillicents.description: Actual cost after engagement complete (paid via Public Fund Safe; cross-link to ledgerEntry txCid)

dataPackagePreparedCid.description: toritate-prepared data package CID (encrypted per ADR-2605181100 if jurisdiction requires confidentiality)

opinionDocumentCid.description: External auditor opinion document CID. G5 INVARIANT: toritate does NOT modify this document; toritate ONLY records the CID.
